title: Cosmic Egg Sorcerer
description: A black spherical sorcerer with a wide grin and colorful patchwork cloak stands inside a giant cracked pink eggshell, holding a glowing green slime creature. Above, an orange winged fish swims through a swirling galaxy portal surrounded by colorful petals and droplets, while miniature castles and potion bottles emerge from clouds and a flower-adorned base.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a black spherical sorcerer with a smiling face and colorful cloak standing inside a giant cracked pink eggshell. He holds a glowing green slime creature. An orange winged fish with pink fins swims near a swirling galaxy vortex in the dark sky. Miniature castles, colorful flowers, potion bottles, and clouds fill the composition in a vibrant, detailed painting style.
